_about: Routing brain for the Owner Cell app. The app loads this and follows it; engine.py executes the steps. Edit numbers here as new runs measure them. Yields are per record entering the paid step. clean = mobile AND not DNC AND not litigator. Measured Sept 2026. v2 (2026-09-21): merged with the Nalify research program. Entries carrying "measured_by": "anas" are Anas's live measurements and must not be edited without a new run. Entries carrying "measured_by": "research_estimate" have n = 0 and expected values from the research modules; the first sample run replaces them. New recipe D adds the register-phone-vs-Maps contrast and the four buckets.

unit_costs_usd._note: telnyx and datazapp are EXPERIMENTAL pre-gates and fallbacks (see 01_MERGED_ARCHITECTURE section 4). They are not in any recipe until the bake-off in Phase 2 measures them against BatchData. Anas rejected DataZapp on cost, coverage or terms in his run; the research found a lower list price, so the disagreement is resolved by measurement, not by document.

A.name: Scrape
A.when: The owner answers the business phone. Works in every US city.

steps.output: businesses with phone, maps link, rating, reviews

rules: keep only rows matching allowlist on category/subtypes/name

steps.keep: type == Mobile AND dnc == false AND tcpa == false (flag mode: keep dnc rows marked)

A.scale_rule: More cells = more cities. Never trace a Lane A record.

B.name: Name → home → trace
B.when: A receptionist answers, or there is no storefront. Needs a state with a name source AND an address source (see states).

steps.output: owner first/last (+ street if the licence file has it)

steps.skip_if: names already carry a home street (fl_re, fl_cpa)
rules: match owner string LAST FIRST% or FIRST LAST
exactly one owner → keep; two different owners → skip
street must have number + name + suffix; no suite/PO box

steps.keep: highest-score Mobile with dnc == false AND tcpa == false; keep email

B.scale_rule: More cells = more names. ~25% of names resolve to a home; ~45% of traces come back clean. 1,000 clean ≈ 2,200 traces ≈ 9,000 names.

C.name: Registry (phone already on file)
C.when: The state prints the licensee's own phone. Always check for this first — 10x cheaper.

steps.note: engine.trace verifies any record that already has a phone instead of tracing it

D.name: Contrast (register phone vs Maps phone)
D.when: A free register carries BOTH a person name AND a phone, and the industry also has Google Maps listings. Adds to recipe C: the register phone is compared with the Maps phone; a different phone is the owner's direct line candidate, an equal phone is the business line. Also produces the 'licensed but invisible' bucket (in register, absent from Maps) which Maps-first competitors cannot see.

steps.output: owner name, register phone, address, license id, issue date

steps.input: trade keyword + the cities present in the register slice
steps.output: Maps phone per business (the contrast line)

rules: match register row to Maps place on normalized business name + address (rapidfuzz, name >= 0.87, address >= 0.90)
bucket 1: in register, no Maps match
bucket 4: Maps only (no register row) -> route to recipe A or B
drop register phones used by more than 3 licences (phone reuse filter)

steps.keep: type == Mobile AND dnc == false AND tcpa == false
steps.note: verify register phone for buckets 1, 2, 3; bucket 3 kept only if Mobile

D.scale_rule: More cells = more register rows. Sort newest licence first (85% mobile on 2020s licences vs 18% on 2000s, Anas). Bucket 1 and 2 first, bucket 3 last.

Exclude AO titles credentialing/billing/office manager and AO name+phone repeated on 3+ orgs (DSO). guardrails: Check job credit cap BEFORE every paid call; on cap → deliver what exists, settle, stop.
Any HTTP error or unexpected body → stop the job, log the body, mark needs_attention. Never retry with another vendor.
Auto-sample ~20 cells first; if clean rate < 50% of expected → stop and refund the hold.
Recipe B: print/log 3 full addresses before the trace fires; drop any without number + street + suffix.
Never call BatchData property search. Never scrape Google for attorneys/CPAs/med spas as the deliverable.
Dedupe against delivered (per user) and suppression (global) before delivery. Re-scrub after 31 days.
Never emit landline/VoIP. Litigator (tcpa) rows are dropped in every mode.
Dial window is 08:00 to 20:00 recipient local time (Florida cap), not 21:00.

Every delivered row carries a ledger record: source register + row id, fetch timestamp, Maps place_id + Maps phone at fetch, bucket, business-line evidence (register == Maps, or verify caller_type business), verify vendor + timestamp, DNC file version, litigator vendor + timestamp, legal gate applied.

Every dial outcome (reached_owner / gatekeeper / wrong_number / voicemail / disconnected / opt_out) is stored with a snapshot of the row's features at dial time. This is the training set for the Owner Probability Score; if it is not captured from the first list it is lost.
Recipe D: drop register phones shared by more than 3 licences (phone reuse); never treat TX TDLR owner_telephone as a second phone.
Never use voter files, DMV data, SC or UT licensee lists, WA liquor lists, NIPR, manufacturer provider locators (Alle, Aspire, device makers) as list sources.
California small family child care home phones are never dialed (HSC 1596.86).

dial_window_local._note: 20:00 not 21:00. Florida Telemarketing Act 501.616(6) caps at 8pm local; use the stricter window everywhere. Max 3 calls per 24h per recipient on the same subject (FL).
